Eye Pattern - Clockwork Pupils.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Clockwork Pupils
Pupils constructed of visible gear-like mechanisms — ticking, adjusting iris apertures with mechanical precision.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Clockwork Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Apply clockwork pupil or iris structures with tiny gear-like shapes and mechanical symmetry. This is an eye appearance detail only; do not create time powers, machine senses, or gameplay bonuses.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
